remarks:
Build your custom estate on this 3-acre Fredonia, NY lot, offering the ideal balance of quiet village living and direct access to metropolitan amenities. Zoned A-R, this property allows for horses, hobby farming, & barndominiums. Ready to start projects on day one? 
The acreage includes a pristine, structurally sound 32 x 60, (2 - 12 foot doors & 16 foot ceilings) pole barn, ideal for equipment & storage. Located minutes from local conveniences and major travel routes (I-90 and Route 20), you can enjoy rural peace while remaining within an hour's drive of major jobs, entertainment, and airports in Buffalo NY & Erie PA.
Village of Fredonia has approved and planned for city water and city sewer to run up Straight Rd to Christy Rd in early 2027
